name: SAVIO Guard
description: On PCs your organization manages with SAVIO, checks text you paste, drop, upload (text files) or send in a form on websites for Aadhaar, PAN, card and bank numbers. Checks run on this PC; your organization sees what kind of data was found and where, never the text. If your organization asks, it also keeps sign-in to services such as Microsoft 365 and Slack to its own accounts. When a downloaded file is uploaded elsewhere, it notes which site the file came from (the site only).
